              Control panel

              Show

              → or Space goes forward, ← goes back. A presentation clicker works too.

                Scoring

                Answers

                On the first question, click a word to hide it. On the light-up screen, click a word to switch it between red, grey and plain. After rehearsal, clear everything: only answers sent after clearing count, and phones get their answers back.

                Team names

                Type them on the team names screen: press a number 1 to 8, type, then Enter. You can also fix them here.

                  Question pictures

                  Choose a picture for each question, or drop it onto the question screen. Pictures stay on this laptop. M on a question switches phones to multiple choice. T starts a 30-second sand clock; press it again to add another, up to three. When time runs out, phones stop taking answers.

                  Name the files by question number, like q2.jpg, q3.png, q12.jpeg.

                    Meme pictures

                    On a meme screen, drop a picture onto it or click the empty frame. Pictures stay on this laptop.

                    Fresh start

                    For each new test run: new QR code, every answer, vote, timer and sample cleared, back to the first screen. Team names and pictures stay.
